title: Teemo Laugh
blurb: A tiny cheerful giggle from the most despised creature in League of Legends. Teemo scatters invisible mushrooms across the map, blinds people, and then makes this exact noise while you die to something you never saw, so the laugh became the community's universal sound for petty, deliberate cruelty. Players have written songs about hating him. The giggle is genuinely sweet in isolation, and that gap is the joke — pair it with any small act of sabotage and the meaning arrives before you have explained anything.
origin: Teemo's laugh from League of Legends.
